subject: Engineering
title: Paper Bridge Challenge
goal: Build a paper bridge spanning 20 cm that holds as many coins as possible.
steps: Predict which fold will be strongest.
Change one design feature and retest.
reflection: What design change improved strength, and why?

subject: Science
title: Best Insulator Test
goal: Compare materials to see which slows cooling best.
steps: Wrap each cup with a different material.
reflection: Which material reduced heat loss most?

subject: Technology
title: Algorithm Treasure Hunt
goal: Write an exact step-by-step algorithm that another person can follow.
steps: Have someone follow only the written steps.

subject: Arts
title: Visual Hierarchy Poster
goal: Design a one-page poster using size, contrast, and spacing to guide the viewer's eye.
steps: Choose a title, subtitle, and three facts.
Ask someone what they noticed first.
measure: Viewer correctly identifies intended visual order
reflection: Which design choice created the strongest emphasis?

subject: Math
title: Measure Your Room
goal: Estimate and then calculate room perimeter and area.
measure: Difference between estimated and measured area
reflection: Why was your estimate high or low?

subject: Technology
title: micro:bit Reaction Timer
goal: Create or plan a reaction-time game using input, output, variables, and timing.
steps: Display score and test multiple trials.
reflection: Which part of the algorithm controls fairness?
